handoff.salientSummary: Delivered Guestbook CRM, six module reports, the bookings and waitlist_entries report subjects and /book/today in tenant-api, plus App Guests list/profile, Reports screen, bookings-today dashboard block, detail-sheet pinned notes, Arabic translations and a Playwright spec. The three carried-over tenant-api fixes are also in. Typecheck, lint, tenant-api (2509 tests), touched App vitest (553) and the e2e spec (9/9 with repeat) pass, and the flows were checked live on acme and riyadh-grill, including ?lng=ar.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Backend: rsv-guestbook-service plus rewritten guest routes (partial search, cursor paging of at most 50, tag CRUD and filter, derived first_visit/frequent_no_show tags, pinned/edited/deleted notes, atomic merge with rsv_guest_merges and booking events, export with includeSensitive, erase), erase-customer unlink hook, reconcile_guest_counters tick task, late-cancel flagging, module report routes (summary, no-shows, cancellations, turn-times, waitlist, pacing) gated on read:reservation_report:any with report.run audit and no contact PII, generic report subjects bookings and waitlist_entries in RESTRICTED_REPORT_SUBJECTS and the App report token, GET /book/today, and pinned notes on guest summaries. Carried-over fixes: notify_available names the restaurant-local date and time with a booking link (migration 0018 and an email render test), availability ETag includes the online and waitlist flags, and the staff test needles no longer collide with epoch-ms timestamps. App: guests.tsx and guests.$guestId.tsx with guest-list-screen, guest-profile-screen, notes panel, merge dialog and guest-profile-card; reports.tsx with reports-screen and panels; the bookings-today block (maxInstances 1, hidden unless reservations.enabled and read:reservation:any, fetches browser-direct, refreshes every 60s); detail-sheet pinned notes, linked-customer badge and profile link; real Arabic msgstr for all new strings. Fixes found during live verification: reservation detail now unwraps the nested guestDetail so the sheet has the guest id and pinned notes, and the block localizes JSON location names.

commandsRun.observation: 0 errors. Remaining warnings are three lingui warnings in $orgSlug_+/index.tsx that were there before and one raw-locator warning in the e2e spec (same pattern as the other reservations specs).

interactiveChecks.action: acme guests list: search by name, phone fragment and an empty query, then tag filter VIP and First visit
interactiveChecks.observed: Search narrows the rows, shows the empty-search state on no match, and the tag filter returns only tagged guests. The guest request carries limit=50.

interactiveChecks.action: Guest profile: create tag, add a pinned note, merge a duplicate, export standard and sensitive, erase
interactiveChecks.observed: The tag appeared on the profile and the pinned note was listed. Merge showed 'Guests merged.' and moved the visit history. Export sent includeSensitive=1 for the sensitive variant. Erase showed the erased notice.

interactiveChecks.action: Today: open Layla's reservation detail sheet
interactiveChecks.observed: The pinned note, the 'Open guest profile' link to /acme/reservations/guests/gst_acme_1 and the profile link are shown (after the guestDetail unwrap fix).
All tabs render data. The empty range shows zeroed totals and empty-state rows. Arabic renders with dir=rtl and localized titles.

interactiveChecks.action: Dashboard: Edit layout, Add block, Bookings today, then reload
interactiveChecks.observed: The block is added once with counts and next arrivals. Network shows browser-direct GET :3007 /book/today with a Bearer token, and a third request came 60s later. /acme/_.data contains no guest names. Location names showed as raw JSON until I fixed that.

interactiveChecks.action: Set reservations.enabled=false on acme and reload the dashboard
interactiveChecks.observed: The saved block is hidden and no longer in the page text. Flag re-enabled afterwards.
Both pages render RTL with Arabic labels. Customers page still loads normally. The console has no errors on a fresh load.
